categories.main_business_segments: Belluna operates eight main business segments: Property (real estate leasing, development, hotels, power generation, golf courses, restaurants), Cosmetics & Health Foods (mail-order cosmetics and supplements), Gourmet (mail-order food, sake, wine), Nurse-related (nurse apparel and staffing), Kimono-related (kimono retail and rental), Apparel & Miscellaneous Goods (catalog and online sales of clothing, household goods), Other (wholesale, travel agency), and Database Utilization (fulfillment, logistics, finance services).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages catalog and internet-based mail-order systems, robust logistics and fulfillment centers, and proprietary customer databases for targeted marketing. It employs IT-driven inventory and order management, and in property, utilizes real estate development and hotel management expertise. Manufacturing is outsourced; Belluna focuses on procurement, distribution, and service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Belluna primarily serves general consumers, especially middle-aged women, through direct-to-consumer channels. It also targets specialized markets such as nurses (for apparel and staffing), kimono enthusiasts, and hospitality customers (hotel guests, restaurant patrons). Its B2B activities include wholesale and fulfillment services for other businesses.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales, but it also has significant property and hotel assets in the US, Sri Lanka, Maldives, and Singapore. Its logistics and fulfillment network is concentrated in Japan, while overseas subsidiaries support property and hospitality expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Belluna operates primarily at the downstream end of the supply chain, focusing on retail, direct sales, and service delivery to end customers. In property and hospitality, it acts as an asset owner and operator. It also provides midstream services such as logistics, fulfillment, and finance for mail-order businesses.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Belluna emphasizes portfolio management, strengthening growth segments (property, cosmetics/health foods, gourmet, nurse-related) and maximizing efficiency in stable segments (apparel, kimono, database services). Key themes include digital transformation, sustainability (CO2 reduction, resource efficiency), and human resource development. The company does not conduct traditional R&D but invests in IT, logistics, and service innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales via catalog and online channels, hotel and restaurant operations, real estate leasing, and service fees from logistics, fulfillment, and finance. Subscription/recurring revenue is present in cosmetics and health foods (regular purchase programs) and finance (loan interest).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Belluna is a leading diversified mail-order and property group in Japan, competing with other catalog/online retailers (e.g., Senshukai, Nissen), specialty mail-order firms, and regional hotel operators. It differentiates itself through a broad portfolio, scale, and integration of retail, property, and service businesses.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, consolidated sales were ¥210.9 billion, with operating profit of ¥11.9 billion and net profit of ¥8.8 billion. The company has nearly 3,900 employees and assets exceeding ¥312 billion. Growth is moderate (1.2% sales increase YoY), with stronger profit recovery (operating profit up 21.5%), and a strategic plan targets further expansion to ¥253.1 billion sales by FY2028.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Belluna’s value proposition centers on convenience, affordability, and variety, offering a wide range of products and services that enrich customers’ daily lives. Its unique strengths include a multi-segment portfolio, nationwide logistics, proprietary customer databases for targeted marketing, and a strong presence in both retail and hospitality. The company emphasizes reliability, customer-centric service, and adaptability to changing consumer needs.
